# Cloud Waste Scanner Community v3.1.1

Community `v3.1.1` is a packaged UI, release, and brand polish update for the 3.1 desktop line.

This release keeps the local-first operating model and focuses on production fit: clearer desktop branding, stronger dark-mode layout behavior, refreshed website presentation, and current platform packages.

## Highlights

- refreshed blue geometric app icon based on the original Cloud Waste Scanner mark
- fixed app menu navigation so each selected workspace opens from the top of the main content area
- improved dark-mode Governance header readability and active navigation styling
- upgraded website UI, blog readability, sharing surfaces, SEO metadata, and Vercel Analytics integration
- refreshed download packaging for Windows and Linux

## Included

- app metadata version bumped to `3.1.1`
- Windows taskbar / installer icon refresh
- website favicon and brand asset refresh
- local main-scroll reset when switching desktop app sections
- Governance page header layout fix for dense action groups
- stable dark topbar transparency classes
- focused blog and whitepaper tone cleanup
- static site SEO metadata, sitemap, and solution-page improvements
